hangover-enabled.name: Enabled
hangover-enabled.description: Enable or disable the entirety of Hangover

hangover-speedchange-enabled.name: Speed Change
hangover-speedchange-enabled.description: Should game speed rapidly change while drunk?

hangover-vfx-enabled.name: Level VFX
hangover-vfx-enabled.description: Should there be visual effects while playing levels while drunk? (vfx are currently only visible in levels that use shader effects. levels that don't use shader effects will not have visible vfx)

hangover-speedchange-title.name: Speed Change Settings
hangover-speedchange-title.description: Controls the speed-change effect from being drunk

hangover-speedchange-audio-only.name: Speed Change Audio Only
hangover-speedchange-audio-only.description: Speed changing only modifies the audio, not the actual speed of the game. This will ruin any sync levels have.

hangover-speedchange-frequency.name: Speed Change Frequency
hangover-speedchange-frequency.description: Modifies how long it takes (in seconds) for the game speed to shift while drunk

hangover-speedchange-intensity.name: Speed Change Intensity
hangover-speedchange-intensity.description: Modifies how intense the speed change is for being drunk

hangover-vfx-title.name: VFX Settings
hangover-vfx-title.description: Controls VFX that change visuals while playing levels

hangover-vfx-blur.name: Radial Blur
hangover-vfx-blur.description: Toggles the radial blur in VFX

hangover-vfx-blur-intensity.name: Radial Blur Intensity
hangover-vfx-blur-intensity.description: Changes the intensity of the radial blur
